required_fixes.finding: The packet's claim-bearing question (spec.json#question, spec.json#hypothesis) is that the bounded 0.2308 advantage 'survives removal of the joint-authorship confound' and 'is a real semantic-selection effect, not a joint-authorship artifact'. report.md section 4 asserts the current 0.3978 'confirm[s] the effect is not a joint-authorship artifact' and section 8 calls it 'First contamination-free evidence'. The only executable authorship evidence is freeze-gate V4 = extracted bank-block sha256 == fb4d3246990731c95f4cf4cfa5870ac7f02da8832eed324580be5f75b1456c6e plus 140 parseable lines. The authorship narrative (prereg.md sections 4-5) is a self-declaration, is inherited byte-identically from the DESIGN-failed packet EXP-GRAPH-38123980914 (failure.json category DESIGN_FAILURE, exit 1), and has no independent artifact, transcript or third-party attestation. V3-CONTAM-SCREEN only removes goals with token set-Jaccard >= 0.60 to a prior authored string and shares its tokenisation with the B-LEXICAL-OVERLAP comparator, so it cannot exclude semantic/style convergence or a curated bank. The maximum justified statement is that the advantage is reproduced on this frozen bank under this self-declared provenance and screen; the confound is mitigated, not proven eliminated.
required_fixes.required_correction: Downgrade report.md sections 4/8 and the corresponding observations to the bounded statement (mitigation, not elimination); do not use 'confirming' or 'contamination-free'.

required_fixes.finding: spec.json labels B-LEXICAL-OVERLAP a 'Strong null'. It is the frozen comparator and it does retain headroom (0.5269 vs the 0.99 ceiling), so V9 is satisfied. But it is weak in absolute terms: an audit-constructed deterministic rule using ONLY the frozen RandomRoleResolver role_keywords plus the resource noun reaches 75/93 = 0.8065, and using the operation-synonym sets that the spec's own hypothesis enumerates (add/register/make/set up/insert; fetch/show/look up/view/bring up; edit/modify/change/revise/adjust/fix; remove/erase/drop/destroy/wipe) plus the resource noun reaches 93/93 = 1.000, above M-MECH-ACC-EMBED = 86/93 = 0.9247. The claim must therefore be stated as 'exceeds the specific token-set-Jaccard null B-LEXICAL-OVERLAP', not as evidence that embedding selection is needed to recover verb synonymy.

validity_findings.finding: V4's executable portion is a hash equality and a 140-line parse; the completeness/independence claims of the provenance record (prereg.md sections 4-5) are not measured. The record is inherited byte-identically from EXP-GRAPH-38123980914, which ended in DESIGN_FAILURE, and is an unaudited self-declaration by the same design process that assembled the bank. The contamination screen mitigates lexical near-copies but shares tokenisation with the comparator and thresholds only token Jaccard, so it cannot establish independence from the registry intents. Per the transmission contract this is a missing measurement, not a negative result: it caps the claim, it does not falsify it.

M-PAIRED-DIFF-EMBED-MINUS-LEXICAL is a family-blocked bootstrap over 5 resource families (B=10000). The seeded recomputation reproduces obs_diff=0.3978494623655914, lower_ci=0.29670329670329665, upper_ci=0.49473684210526314 exactly. With only 5 resampling blocks the percentile interval can be optimistic, so the CI should not be over-trusted; the qualitative conclusion is nevertheless robust because the discordant pairs are embed-only-correct b=38 vs lexical-only-correct c=1 and the per-family differences are positive in all 5 families (users +0.526, posts +0.353, comments +0.211, albums +0.526, photos +0.368) and all 4 verb strata are positive (+0.053 create, +0.480 read, +0.208 update, +0.760 delete).

baseline_findings.finding: The frozen comparator is real and distinct (V9: disagreement_count=41, lexical accuracy 0.5269 < 0.99) and it is not pinned, so the primary contrast is genuine. But it is not a strong null. Audit-constructed deterministic baselines (NOT producer metrics, added only to probe comparator strength): (a) frozen RandomRoleResolver role_keywords + resource noun = 75/93 = 0.8065; (b) the operation-synonym sets enumerated in the spec's own hypothesis + resource noun = 93/93 = 1.000. Both are simple lexical/dictionary procedures; (b) exceeds M-MECH-ACC-EMBED = 0.9247. The measured advantage therefore establishes superiority over token-set-Jaccard specifically, not over lexical resolution in general.

Reproduced B-RANDOM-ROLE = 21/93 = 0.2258 (<= 0.35 gate, close to the 0.20 chance floor), B-INCUMBENT-KERNEL = 0/93 by construction (exact-intent equality), B-INTERNAL-ID-ORACLE = 93/93 by construction. The oracle and incumbent results are structural tautologies and carry no discriminative information; the random-role floor is genuine but only weakly above chance. These do not threaten the primary contrast but they cannot be cited as independent corroboration.

The screen that defines the primary set uses the comparator's tokenisation and screens against the comparator's reference strings, so it could in principle remove goals the comparator would answer and inflate the treatment-lexical gap. Recomputed counterfactually this does NOT happen on this bank: on all 100 applicable goals embed=93/100 and lexical=55/100 (diff 0.3800); on the 93-goal primary set embed=86/93 and lexical=49/93 (diff 0.3978). The 7 screen-removed applicable goals were embed-correct 7/7 and lexical-correct 6/7, so the screen slightly REDUCED the observed gap. The design_review.json nonblocking concern is thus empirically immaterial here, though the coupling remains a design property to carry forward.

Reproduced NC-SHUFFLED-LABEL=0.0 (<=0.20) and NC-RANDOM-SCORE=0.043 (<=0.25) through the shared argmax-over-20 + mechanism-id credit rule. These confirm the credit rule is not leaking fixture structure. NC-SHUFFLED-LABEL=0.0 exactly is expected for a derangement at 1/20 chance and is not itself informative beyond passing.

claim_ceiling: MAXIMUM JUSTIFIED CLAIM (bounded, this packet only): On this single frozen 140-goal bank, after the frozen V3 token-overlap screen removes 9 near-copies, max-cosine-similarity selection over the 20 frozen intent embeddings (A-EMBED-COSINE, EmbeddingArgmaxResolver) attains mechanism-identity accuracy 86/93 = 0.9247 and strictly exceeds the frozen token-set-Jaccard comparator (B-LEXICAL-OVERLAP) at 49/93 = 0.5269 on the 93-goal contamination-screened primary set; the paired family-blocked difference M-PAIRED-DIFF-EMBED-MINUS-LEXICAL = 0.3978 with a seeded 95% bootstrap interval [0.2967, 0.4947], and the direction is robust across all 5 resource families and all 4 operation strata (38 embed-only-correct vs 1 lexical-only-correct). The measurement transaction is valid: freeze binding, bank hash, all 12 gates, controls and derived artifacts were independently reproduced. This does NOT license: (i) the claim that the prior 0.2308 advantage was 'confirmed' to be free of the joint-authorship confound, because the authorship independence rests on a self-declared narrative inherited from the DESIGN-failed EXP-GRAPH-38123980914 and V4 only checks a hash; (ii) 'contamination-free' evidence, because the screen removes only token-overlap near-copies; (iii) any claim that embedding argmax is needed to recover verb synonymy, because the comparator is a weak token-Jaccard null that simple keyword-synonym rules can exceed; (iv) generalization beyond this 20-mechanism/5-family fixture, this bank, or the unpinned all-MiniLM-L6-v2 checkpoint; (v) any applicability/abstention capability, since M-ABSTENTION is AB-NOT-MET; (vi) parameter binding, execution correctness or product promotion. The justified registry direction is bounded support for the embedding-selection sub-mechanism of C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE (C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE currently HYPOTHESIS in codex/claim_state.json.effective_event_by_claim), contingent on correcting the report.md over-claims in RQF-01.

UNRES-03: Whether a structured keyword-synonym or retrieval-based resolver would match or exceed A-EMBED-COSINE on a bank not constructed around the synonym sets enumerated in the spec's own hypothesis is unanswered; the audit probe (spec-enumerated synonyms + resource noun = 1.000) suggests it might.
